title: Hugo Ekitike stretchered off in first half of Liverpool’s Champions League tie vs PSG
content:
Liverpool striker Hugo Ekitike was stretchered off in the first half of Tuesday’s Champions League quarter final decider against Paris Saint-Germain at Anfield.

The France international went down unchallenged shortly before the half-hour mark, and clutched his lower right leg – suggesting he may have suffered an Achilles injury.

Ekitike appeared in some distress before he was stretchered off and replaced by Mohamed Salah, who started on the bench against the holders again.

An major injury Ekitike would be a blow to Liverpool’s hopes of a strong finish to the season, with Arne Slot’s side aiming for Champions League qualification via a top-five finish in the Premier League and hoping to overturn a 2-0 deficit from the first leg against PSG.

The situation will also be a concern for France. It is 58 days until the World Cup gets under way in the U.S., Canada and Mexico this summer, and Ekitike has recently established himself as a key part of Didier Deschamps’ squad – scoring twice in his first eight international appearances.
